title: Huh? (Dog)
blurb: Canine confusion, and considerably more emotionally involved than its feline equivalent. Where the huh cat is merely baffled, the huh dog is personally concerned about what you have just said and would like to help if it can only understand the problem. That is the difference between the two species in a single reaction. Play it for statements requiring a double-take: sudden plans, weird requests, arithmetic performed out loud. The confusion is entirely mutual, entirely sincere, and adorable in a way the cat version never manages.
origin: The viral confused dog reaction meme sound.
